bio:
Ashtray Radio w/ Spliffany

*Monthly*

Spliffany is an atlanta born dj whose sound captures the essence of catching two twerks at once while throwing ass at the exact time that you start peaking at the most beautiful and rare party you’ve ever been to and there’s drum and bass playing and everyone loves it and no one is in pain and everyone’s joy is in perfect sync basically..<3
title: Spliffany
